entities.summary: Yeoyang Jin clan is one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan is in Hongseong County, South Chungcheong Province. According to the research held in 2015, the number of Yeoyang Jin clan’s member was 110,403. Their founder was Jin Chong hu who worked as Hanlin Academy in Song dynasty and a Jin Jun’s grandchild. Jin Jun was naturalized in Goryeo to avoid an invasion from Jin dynasty (1115–1234). Jin Chong hu made some achievements when he suppressed rebellion of Yi Cha-gyŏm who was Injong of Goryeo’s maternal relative.
